title: Text: DET Marc Himelstein ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Can you give me Ashley Baughman’s number?

The reason why I am asking is because for that story, I am trying to pursue a yes or no, anonymous question from all the females that left the organization last year - does the organization have a sexism problem?
I won’t tell her I got it from you
Yes it does
But I don’t have it.  I deleted it in September.
I have no way to reach her
Ok
So, more officially, 1) Does the Tigers organization overall have a sexism problem? 2) Does the ticket office have a sexism problem?
Sorry I didn’t get back to you on the Gallaraga stuff.  I had some really good stories. I started my new job and just forgot.
Oh nice.... What are you doing
I am the GM of Road Runner Sports Wilmette.
In Illinois
Just popped it into google. So did you move the fam down there
How do you like it so far?
Yes it does Yes it does the ticket sales department
Yes.  Back home for us
So far it’s been great
If you aren’t an “attractive girl” there is no place in sales.
There
That was talked about all the time n
Or white
I’m dying to read the article
When’s it going to publish
I’d say probably next couple weeks
Nice
Did you talk to Duane
Not yet
I’m not optimistic but I’m gonna have to cold call him once I have enough beer the next couple days lol
How many years were you with the Tigers
Hahah
Almost 12
Ty
He probably tell you more on November 1
Is that when his contract runs up
End of oct
